scheme_name: Incentive For The Devadasi Children’s Marriage to Schedule Tribe
other_conditions: Both spouses must belong to the Hindu religion
Marriage must have taken place on or after 1 April 2019
Application must be submitted within 18 months of the marriage
One spouse must belong to the Scheduled Tribe community and be a resident of Karnataka
The marriage must be between an ST individual and a non‑ST individual, or between two ST individuals
Both spouses must be residents of Karnataka
benefits_summary: A cash incentive of ₹8,00,000 is provided to the married couple, with ₹5,00,000 for the bride and ₹3,00,000 for the groom.
